The issue: long runs of G-C form alternative pairings (sliding). The multiloop region (12-21 pairing with 19-32 etc) is misaligning because all-G on one side and all-C on other allows sliding. I need to break symmetry — use mixed pairs (some A-U, alternating) to lock register. Let me think about the pairing topology carefully.

The structure is a nested multiloop. The pairing partners:
- 5-81, 6-80, 7-79, 8-78 (4bp outer)
- 9-76, 10-75, 11-74 (3bp)
- 12-21, 13-20, 14-19 (hairpin 1 stem, 3bp) — this is hairpin unit[0]
- 22-73, 23-72, 24-71 (3bp)
- 29-70, 30-69, 31-68, 32-67 (4bp)
- 34-44, 35-43, 36-42 (hairpin 2 stem) — unit[1]
- 46-66, 47-65, 48-64 (3bp)
- 49-60, 50-59, 51-58 (hairpin 3 stem) — unit[2]

The runs of consecutive pairs on the same strand need to pair in order. The problem is that consecutive G's at 12,13,14 can pair with C's at 19,20,21 OR slide to 73,72,71. To prevent sliding, I should use non-repetitive pair patterns. Let me use a mix where adjacent pairs alternate so only the correct register is complementary.

# Build sequence with register-locked pairs using varied complementary pairing
t='.....((((((((((....)))(((....((((.(((.....))).((((((......)))...))))))))))))).))))....................'
n=102
pairs=[(5,81),(6,80),(7,79),(8,78),(9,76),(10,75),(11,74),(12,21),(13,20),(14,19),
       (22,73),(23,72),(24,71),(29,70),(30,69),(31,68),(32,67),(34,44),(35,43),(36,42),
       (46,66),(47,65),(48,64),(49,60),(50,59),(51,58)]
# Assign unique-ish patterns to lock register.
# Use a pattern: G-C, C-G, A-U, U-A alternating per stem group
# Define stems (contiguous runs):
stems = {
 'outer_a':[(5,81),(6,80),(7,79),(8,78)],   # 4bp
 'outer_b':[(9,76),(10,75),(11,74)],         # 3bp
 'hp1':[(12,21),(13,20),(14,19)],            # 3bp hairpin1 stem
 'mid_a':[(22,73),(23,72),(24,71)],          # 3bp
 'mid_b':[(29,70),(30,69),(31,68),(32,67)],  # 4bp
 'hp2':[(34,44),(35,43),(36,42)],            # 3bp hairpin2 stem
 'mid_c':[(46,66),(47,65),(48,64)],          # 3bp
 'hp3':[(49,60),(50,59),(51,58)],            # 3bp hairpin3 stem
}
# pattern templates: each stem gets a distinct sequence on 5' side, complementary on 3'
# 5' -> 3' complement: A<->U, C<->G
import itertools
# Choose 5' sequences that are unique per stem so they cannot cross-pair
patterns = {
 'outer_a':'GCGA',   # comp UCGC... wait reverse complement
 'outer_b':'AUG',
 'hp1':'GCA',
 'mid_a':'CUG',
 'mid_b':'GACA',
 'hp2':'AGC',
 'mid_c':'UGC',
 'hp3':'GAC',
}
def revcomp(s):
    comp={'A':'U','U':'A','C':'G','G':'C'}
    return ''.join(comp[c] for c in reversed(s))

seq=['A']*n
# fill stems: 5' side left->right is pattern; 3' side filled as revcomp at right positions
